params.name: boundaryIds
params.description: Accepts comma separated multiple boundary ids.

params.name: profile
params.description: Applicable on ranged variables. Returns top sorted result based on the input value.

params.name: filter
params.description: Accept the comma separated theme names and filter response based on value. Maximum 10 can be provided.

params.name: valueFormat
params.description: Applicable for few ranged variables where percent & count both are available and filter response based on the input value.

params.name: variableLevel
params.description: Retrieves demographic facts in response based on the input value.

items.docs: This endpoint will allow the user to request demographics details by census boundary id. Multiple comma separated boundary ids will be accepted.
